headline: Fronts Surge Across Palantine and Marban
war_summary: Since the last edition, Palantine Berm has widened its lead as the war’s busiest ledger, recording 61 strategic-base events in twenty-four hours and five in the latest two; its split remains four Warden, three Colonial, with no neutral holdings. Marban Hollow has sharpened markedly, rising to 35 daily events and eight in two hours, while its field now shows two Warden, three Colonial, and three neutral bases. Weathered Expanse has reached 29 daily events, six in the latest two, but its present division—six Warden, one Colonial, and two neutral—differs substantially from the previous report. Linn Mercy remains a costly, fluid sector with 24 daily events and no fresh action in the latest two hours; eight Colonial bases stand against three neutral, with casualties accelerating on both sides. Gutter has become a new flashpoint, posting eight daily events and three in the latest two, amid a six-Warden, one-Colonial balance. Farranac Coast has also seen a fresh neutralization, though its broader activity is concentrated in the latest hours. The war remains undecided.
